output.title: Dollar threshold for escalating a specialty pharmacy case to the pharmacy director
output.draft_text:
Specialty pharmacy cases are escalated to the pharmacy director when the [cost measure, e.g., per-fill cost, monthly cost, or annual projected cost] of the specialty medication meets or exceeds [dollar threshold amount].

What counts toward the threshold: [describe how the dollar amount is calculated, e.g., plan-paid amount, total allowed amount, or ingredient cost; and whether it applies per claim, per month, or per year].

When a case meets the threshold:
1. Confirm the medication is classified as specialty under [specialty drug list or classification source].
2. Verify the dollar amount using [system or report used to verify cost].
3. Route the case to the pharmacy director through [escalation channel, queue, or form].
4. Include [required case documentation, e.g., member ID, drug name, NDC, prescriber, cost details, prior authorization status].
5. Let the member know the case is under review and that the expected review time is [review turnaround time].

Cases below the threshold are handled by [team or role that handles below-threshold specialty cases].

Exceptions: [any exceptions, e.g., urgent or expedited cases, specific drug classes, or plan types that follow a different threshold or path].

If you are unsure whether a case meets the threshold, contact [escalation contact or supervisor role].

[system or report used to verify cost]

author_checklist: Confirm the exact dollar threshold that triggers escalation to the pharmacy director and cite the source policy.
Confirm whether the threshold is measured per claim, per fill, per month, or annually, and which cost figure is used (plan-paid, allowed amount, ingredient cost, etc.).
Confirm whether the threshold differs by plan type, line of business, client, or drug class.
Confirm the definition or list used to classify a medication as specialty.
Confirm the escalation channel, required documentation, and turnaround time for pharmacy director review.
Confirm which team handles specialty cases below the threshold.
Confirm any exceptions, such as urgent or expedited requests.
Confirm the escalation contact for advocates who are unsure.
Verify that the pharmacy director role is the correct and current approver title.
Remove any steps or sections that do not apply once facts are confirmed.
